name: booksy-mcp
description: Booksy Biz through your own logged-in browser tab. No session tokens leave the browser.
long_description: Reads a Booksy Biz salon panel (calendar, staff, clients, payments, report exports) through your own logged-in Chrome tab. It needs Chrome 121 or newer with the Booksy MCP Bridge extension, which is included in this bundle in the `extension/dist` folder and attached to every GitHub release as a zip. Traffic is paced on purpose and write tools are off by default. Unofficial, not affiliated with Booksy.
